projects.name: CSS corp pvt ltd
details: Healthcare Claims Denial Prediction & Revenue Recovery Optimization (Python, SQL, Power BI, Azure, Scikit-learn)
Developed a predictive analytics solution to flag high-risk medical claims pre-submission, reducing denials and accelerating reimbursements for a multi-specialty hospital network.
Designed Azure Data Factory ETL workflows to unify EHR, payer, and billing datasets, and applied ML models (logistic regression, gradient boosting) achieving ~85% recall for high-risk claims.
Built Power BI dashboards to monitor KPIs such as first-pass acceptance rates, denial trends, and A/R cycle times.
Implemented automated pre-submission checks, lowering denial rates by 18% and improving cash flow by 12% in three months.
